41	    server, rather than the WSGI application, which is why it's not set by
42	    default. Not setting it anywhere would be an issue with that application,
43	    not with Werkzeug.
44	-   :attr:`~Request.max_form_memory_size` - Stop parsing ``multipart/form-data``
45	    if any non-file part is larger than this number of bytes. File parts can
46	    be larger, they are moved to disk at this limit. The default is 500kB. This
47	    is an additional check, it does not replace ``max_content_length``.
48	-   :attr:`~Request.max_form_parts` - Stop parsing ``multipart/form-data`` if
49	    more than this number of parts are received. This is useful to stop a very
50	    large number of very small fields, especially files. The default is 1000.
51	    This is an additional check, it does not replace ``max_content_length``.
52	
53	Each of these values can be set on the ``Request`` class to affect the default
54	for all requests, or on a ``request`` instance to change the behavior for a
55	specific request. For example, a small limit can be set by default, and a large
56	limit can be set on an endpoint that accepts video uploads. These values should
57	be tuned to the specific needs of your application and endpoints.
58	
59	Using Werkzeug to set these limits is only one layer of protection. WSGI servers
60	and HTTPS servers should set their own limits on size and timeouts. The
61	operating system or container manager should set limits on memory and processing
62	time for server processes.
63	
64	If a 413 Content Too Large error is returned before the entire request is read,
65	clients may show a "connection reset" failure instead of the 413 error. This is
66	based on how the WSGI/HTTP server and client handle connections, it's not
67	something the WSGI application (Werkzeug) has control over.
68	
69	
70	WSGI Server Input Termination
71	-----------------------------
72	
73	The raw WSGI input stream (``environ["wsgi.input"]``) is not safe to read
74	directly for a number of reasons. While not part of the WSGI spec, it is widely
75	accepted that the WSGI server should handle waiting for available data,
76	buffering, and detect EOF or end of chunked input to terminate the stream. The
77	WSGI server indicates that it does this by setting
78	``environ["wsgi.input_terminated"] = True``. Otherwise, Werkzeug will only
79	allow reading the stream if ``Content-Length`` is set.
80	
81	If the WSGI server sets ``wsgi.input_terminated``, this does not mean that the
82	stream is not infinite, only that it will be properly buffered and terminated if
83	it does end. Therefore, you must set limits as described above, or otherwise
84	be prepared to handle infinite streams.
85	
86	
87	Reading the Stream in Middleware
88	--------------------------------
89	
90	When writing WSGI middleware, it is important to remember that the input stream
91	can only be read once. If middleware reads it, it will not be available to the
92	application.
93	
94	Most middleware should not need to read the stream. In rare cases where it does,
95	you can replace the stream with what you've read to avoid this in some cases.
96	
97	.. code-block:: python
98	
99	    environ["wsgi.input"] = BytesIO(request.data)
100	    return wrapped_app(environ, start_response)
101	
102	However, this will cause the entire stream to be stored in memory for the
103	remainder of the request. Therefore it will also not work for infinite streams.

全部完成，1002 个测试全部通过。总结改动：

## 实现内容

**`src/werkzeug/wrappers/request.py`**
- 新增 `Request.max_file_size`（单文件限额）和 `Request.max_total_file_size`（本次请求全部文件累计限额），默认 `None` 维持原行为，并在 `_private_make_form_data_parser` 中传入解析器。

**`src/werkzeug/formparser.py`**
- `_parse_form_data`、`_FormDataParser`、`MultiPartParser` 都接受 `max_file_size` / `max_total_file_size` 参数并逐层传递。
- 两个解析器在 `__init__` 校验：负数直接抛 `ValueError`（配置错误）。校验放在 `_FormDataParser.__init__`，确保不会被 `parse()` 里 `silent` 模式的 `except ValueError` 吞掉。
- `MultiPartParser.parse` 的 Data 事件里，对文件 part 按**实际收到的字节**逐块计数（不信 part 头里的 `Content-Length`），先检查再写流：`file_size + len(data) > max_file_size` 或累计超 `max_total_file_size` 就抛 413，**超额那块不会写入目标流**；恰好等于限额放行；`0` 只放行空文件。普通字段走原有 `max_form_memory_size` 逻辑，不占文件额度；同名多附件通过累计计数器自然覆盖。
- 异常清理复用并验证了现有机制：`MultiPartParser.__exit__` 在异常时关闭 `self._files` 里**所有**已建文件流（含已收完的附件），`_FormDataParser._parse_multipart` 的 `with` 保证触发；成功路径不关流，`FileStorage` 正常读。

**`src/werkzeug/sansio/multipart.py`（顺带修的解码器 bug）**
- 测试发现：当 chunk 恰好切在结尾边界 `--boundary--` 的第一个 `-` 后，`_last_partial_boundary_index` 的安全窗口没算 epilogue 的 `--`，会把边界前缀的 `\r` 当成文件正文吐出（小 buffer 下文件内容被污染、计数也会错）。已把窗口长度加上 `b"--"`，任意 buffer 切分下文件内容都正确——这也保证了"boundary 切到任意位置不能绕过/干扰检查"。
